title: Time difference between now and New Year
description:
Calculate the time difference between now and new year.

Python-Gym adaptation: reading the live clock would make the expected result non-deterministic, so implement as time_until_new_year(now), taking a fixed datetime.datetime object now instead of the real current time, and returning the timedelta between now and midnight of the next 1 January after it.
starter_code:
import datetime

def time_until_new_year(now):
    # your code here
    pass
hints: Subtracting one datetime object from another gives you a timedelta representing the difference between them.
New Year always falls on the next 1 January - build that target datetime using now.year + 1 as the year, month 1, day 1.
Construct next_new_year = datetime.datetime(year=now.year + 1, month=1, day=1) and return next_new_year - now.
expected_behavior: Given a fixed 'now' datetime, returns the timedelta remaining until midnight of the following 1 January.
solution:
import datetime

def time_until_new_year(now):
    next_new_year = datetime.datetime(year=now.year + 1, month=1, day=1)
    return next_new_year - now

hidden_tests.label: time left from 2023-12-25 10:00:00 to New Year
time left from just after New Year to the next one

explanation: Subtracting one datetime.datetime from another produces a datetime.timedelta representing the elapsed time between them. Building next_new_year with now.year + 1 guarantees the target is always the next upcoming New Year relative to now, regardless of what date now falls on.
